review_notes.evidence: Own native overview, all 20 gate fields and physical contacts, new lower 0505 gate/card/pin families, three paired OR outputs and their local joins, all sixteen internal stems, native bit/control rails including the extra ST control sources and reordered rows inspected. The normal bank lattice remains present despite whole-scan origin near the left image edge. The white scan strip destroys several left text prefixes and the left vertical identifier; unreadable text is flagged rather than silently restored from related pages. Eight connector rows and native SDD footer/title/revision inspected.

The white strip erases data/control prefixes and the left vertical page label/subpage field. Intact references and right-hand page identifiers provide contextual readings only; diagram uses replacement characters. Original neighboring scans are RT711 before and RT715 after.
